headline: Ace Combat 8 is out now!
title: Ace Combat 8 Wings of Theve Is Out Now | Fighter Jet Game | Gaming News
video_script: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is out now! Bandai Namco's flight combat game launched on October first, twenty twenty six, on PS5, Xbox Series X and S and PC. You take to the skies in fighter jets and battle it out in huge aerial dogfights. If you love flight games, this is one of the year's big releases. Have you played it yet? Comment below!
description: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve launched on October 1, 2026 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.
